verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair axis for a terminal emulator, since some terminals build in AI command input. The evidence shows only scriptable remote control (`kitten @` commands, verified hands-on), which an external agent could build on but which is not a natural-language interface. Nothing in the pack documents kitty itself accepting natural-language commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
